alexa_acme: Hi team — our production calls to /v1/generate are suddenly slow (200-800ms -> 1.8-2.3s) and some completions look garbled. We traced it: requests got routed to us-west-2 and then the service fell back to a quantized variant. Output contains invalid tokens and role markers missing. Request id: rwd-0c7a2f. Can you escalate?

leo_support: Sorry you're seeing this, Alexa. Can you paste the full request headers (remove secrets) and a small example of the malformed output? Also, did you notice any 4xx/5xx?

alexa_acme: headers: 
```
X-Redwood-Region: eu-central-1
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
User-Agent: acme-bot/1.4
```
example malformed output: \"assistant: Hello
�oops\" (some bytes render as replacement chars). We saw intermittent 502s earlier. We never set a region override. Customer uses model: redwood-v2.1.

leo_support: Thanks. Forwarding to SRE + ML. Jamie, can you check routing logs for rwd-0c7a2f and if there was a cross-region hop?

jamie_sre: Looking now — I see the request entered eu-central-1 but routed to us-west-2 due to a transient capacity shortfall at 1790124679. There was an automated fallback to a compatible variant: redwood-v2.1-q4_0 (quantized). The routing policy allowed cross-region failover because latency SLOs for that customer tier were not strictly pinned.

porfi_eng-ml: Important note: redwood-v2.1-q4_0 uses a slightly different tokenizer packing (byte-pair variant) with vocab id offset compared to the float model. Normally we only fallback to q8_0 which preserves the tokenizer mapping. It looks like the compatibility check misclassified q4_0 as compatible. That explains invalid token ids and missing role tokens.

alexa_acme: Is that a config bug? We rely on role tokens for structured output. This change broke downstream parsing and triggered a billing spike from retries.

leo_support: We're sorry about the disruption. We're treating this as an incident and will open an internal ticket. For a short-term mitigation, can you set a model pin in your request: {"model": "redwood-v2.1@stable"} or add header X-Redwood-Region: eu-central-1 to lock routing? We'll also push a rollback.

jamie_sre: Repro steps I used: 1) Sent the same request with original auth to eu-central-1 endpoint; 2) Simulated capacity drop on eu cluster; 3) observed auto-route to us-west-2 and variant map returned redwood-v2.1-q4_0. Logged router decision: 
```
{ route_decision: "fallback", from: "eu-central-1", to: "us-west-2", variant: "redwood-v2.1-q4_0", compatibility_check: "passed (bug)" }
```
Also captured worker logs showing tokenizer init warning: "vocab-size mismatch: expected 50272 got 50273" and later "tokenizer: unknown token id 65535".

porfi_eng-ml: Root cause appears to be a metadata tag mismatch in the variant registry: q4_0 variant was missing the tokenizer-mapping: v2.1 field. The compatibility scanner considered architecture and sequence-length heuristics but didn't validate tokenizer fingerprint. We'll patch the scanner to verify tokenizer checksum before allowing fallback.

leo_support: Action items: 1) jamie: temporarily disable cross-region fallback for eu-central-1 -> us-west-2 for this customer segment (ETA 30m). 2) porfi: emergency patch to variant compatibility validation and mark q4_0 as incompatible until revalidated (ETA 2-4h). 3) Support: send customer mitigation steps + credit for retries.

alexa_acme: Thanks. Please also open a billing investigation so we don't get charged for automatic retries. We have customers downstream who were impacted.

jamie_sre: Ack — will attach router logs to the incident and flag for billing. infra-bot: incident created: INC-20260317-842.

infra-bot: Incident INC-20260317-842 created by jamie_sre. Severity: P2. Links: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-20260317-842

porfi_eng-ml: Will push the compatibility patch to canary in 45m and revert offending variant mapping. After patch, we'll run a job that brute-forces a few tokenization checks across variants to ensure no further mismatches.

leo_support: I'll follow up in this thread when mitigation is live and share a postmortem once we have RCA. Sorry again for the outage, Alexa. :hands_together:

alexa_acme: Appreciated — please keep us posted. We pinned the model in prod while you patch.
